name: @malipetek/dsh-external-agents
description: Host external ACP agents (Claude Code, Devin, opencode, DeepSeek Harness itself) as first-class agents inside DeepSeek Harness, with delegation: an external agent gets one MCP tool, `delegate`, and commands harness workers that run on the harness's own models.

meta.title: External Agents
meta.description: Run Claude Code, Devin, opencode or another DeepSeek Harness as an external ACP agent, pick which one handles a task, and let it delegate work to harness workers.

author: Muhammet Ali Petek
